home.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity design concept for the existing Personal OS Mac application.
Input image 1 is the CURRENT RUNNING APP SCREENSHOT and is a visual reference, not a screenshot to reproduce verbatim. Continue its established night theme: abyssal blue-black ocean/gothic environment, silver-haired character artwork on the right in the background, tiny cyan glow and restrained crimson accents, dark translucent readable panels, elegant Chinese serif display headings, clean Chinese sans-serif body text, thin cool borders, subtle rounded corners. Keep the Personal OS brand, configurable nickname 博士, fixed left navigation, top search, and atmosphere recognizable. Improve hierarchy and space usage while remaining recognizably this application.
Render ONE flat front-facing desktop application screen, landscape approximately 16:10, crisp high-resolution Chinese text. No device bezel, perspective, annotation arrows, design-board collage, marketing copy, or extra decorative objects. All records, files and timestamps below are fictional illustrative content, not actual user data.
Sidebar exact labels: 首页, 记录, 学习, 任务, 项目, 情报, 审核, 历史; 设置 at bottom. Preserve small familiar outline icons, ample consistent row spacing and restrained crimson active indicator. Keep a narrow left rail and generous main workspace. Text panels sufficiently opaque that body text remains readable over the character art. This is the Mac-first release: show Codex only as selected Agent, no Android UI or fake DSH/Kimi connection status.
Primary request: Design the evolved HOME page that adds fast capture and continuation of learning to the current task-oriented app. Select 首页. Keep the same night background and character identity/style as the reference; adjust cropping to keep the face mostly in the upper-right atmosphere, not behind key text.
Top search exact text: 搜索记录、主题、任务…
Small greeting: 晚上好，博士。  Secondary line: 先记下来，再继续一件重要的事。
Main content layout:
1. Wide compact quick-capture panel directly below the greeting, title 随手记, placeholder 此刻，有什么想记下来？, small attachment action 添加资料 and clear crimson 保存记录 button. This is the most accessible input but should not consume the whole screen.
2. Two-column workspace below: wide left ~65% is 继续学习 with two distinct restrained topic cards. First: Python 装饰器; 上次停在：参数传递与返回值; summary 还没弄清包装函数如何接收参数，下次从一个小练习继续。; small metadata Codex · 昨天; action 继续学习. Second: 英语阅读; 上次停在：长句拆解; small metadata Codex · 3 天前; action 查看总结. A smaller link 全部主题 →.
Right ~35% contains 当前状态 with text 精力一般，今天轻量推进 and small text 有效至 10月6日 plus 修改; below is 今日任务 with two short example tasks: 整理装饰器练习, 阅读一篇短文. Link 查看全部任务 →. Keep these secondary to capture/continuation.
3. Bottom horizontal area 最近记录 with two modest rows and 本周想法回顾 with one relevant old idea. Recent records: 给常用脚本加一个计时工具; 长句先找主干，再看修饰. Review idea: 给常用脚本加一个计时工具. Reason: 与你正在学习的装饰器有关，可以用作练习。 Actions: 接着想, 暂时搁置. Avoid wall-of-cards overload. The app must feel usable and calm, not a fantasy poster.
Show enough whitespace and hierarchy for a coherent single viewport. Retain small existing task/project entry points through the sidebar. No exaggerated statistics, progress gamification or claims of 已掌握.

Continue its established night theme: abyssal blue-black ocean/gothic environment, silver-haired character artwork on the right in the background, tiny cyan glow and restrained crimson accents, dark translucent readable panels, elegant Chinese serif display headings, clean Chinese sans-serif body text, thin cool borders, subtle rounded corners. Keep the Personal OS brand, configurable nickname 博士, fixed left navigation, top search, and atmosphere recognizable. Improve hierarchy and space usage while remaining recognizably this application.
Render ONE flat front-facing desktop application screen, landscape approximately 16:10, crisp high-resolution Chinese text. No device bezel, perspective, annotation arrows, design-board collage, marketing copy, or extra decorative objects. All records, files and timestamps below are fictional illustrative content, not actual user data.
Sidebar exact labels: 首页, 记录, 学习, 任务, 项目, 情报, 审核, 历史; 设置 at bottom. Preserve small familiar outline icons, ample consistent row spacing and restrained crimson active indicator. Keep a narrow left rail and generous main workspace. Text panels sufficiently opaque that body text remains readable over the character art. This is the Mac-first release: show Codex only as selected Agent, no Android UI or fake DSH/Kimi connection status.
Primary request: Design the LEARNING TOPIC SUMMARY view, the central reading and continuation surface. Select 学习. Same established night-theme app frame as the reference but reduce header artwork height to prioritize reading.
Top breadcrumb 学习 / Python 装饰器. Topic heading Python 装饰器. Discreet controls Codex ▾ and 带着学 ▾ at upper right, so the user visibly chooses the Agent. Below: tabs 总结, 对话, 资料 with 总结 selected. Primary crimson action 继续学习.
Main content layout: a generous readable report column about 72% and a narrow sources/context column about 28%. Do not show an additional chat pane on this summary tab. Report is an elegant dark translucent paper-like panel, not separate floating cards for every paragraph.
Report top small status 已整理至 14:32, actions 编辑 and 更新总结. Clear heading 从函数包装，到理解装饰器.
Short continuation paragraph: 你想看懂项目里的 @timer。上次已讨论函数包装，并看过计时例子；仍需弄清参数传递和返回值。下一次从一个双参数函数练习继续。
Then section 关键理解 with 3 numbered readable points:
1. 装饰器接收函数，返回包装后的函数。
   @timer 可以理解为 f = timer(f)，函数名随后指向新的包装函数。 small inline source pill 原对话 ↗.
2. 包装函数可以在调用前后插入行为。
   计时逻辑放在原函数调用前后，同时保留原来的返回结果。 small source pill 代码例子 ↗.
3. 参数需要继续传给原函数。
   *args 和 **kwargs 用来接收并转交参数；这部分还需要练习验证。 small source pill 原对话 ↗.
Small neutral evidence badge 已讨论，尚无独立练习记录.
Section 尚未解决, text 如何接收两个参数，并把计算结果原样返回？
Section 下一步 · AI 建议, text 给一个相加函数加上计时包装，检查返回结果是否保持一致。 An unobtrusive 开始这个练习 button.
Narrow right column:
来源 with sample entries 对话 · 9月29日 and decorators.pdf · 第3页; tiny source labels enable provenance.
关联旧记录 with 给常用脚本加一个计时工具 and reason 你上周的想法，可以作为这次练习的应用场景。 action 查看原记录.
Bottom small typography 总结由 Codex 整理 · 可修改, 历史版本, 导出 Markdown. Avoid internal metadata like tokens, job queues, source hashes, API parameters. No fake mastery percentages, no extra agent personas, no noisy assistant avatars. Preserve hierarchy, comfortable line length, and allow the report body to scroll if needed.
Input image 2 is the newly generated HOME concept. Match its sidebar width, navigation labels, character art, dark panel colors, border radii, typography and red button styling as the same application. Image 1 remains the original live app reference. Produce the distinct learning summary page, not another home page.
